summary: All pages are visually intact on desktop and mobile with perfect accessibility, best-practices, and SEO scores. Performance on /, /projects/note-structurer, and /projects/screenshot-to-primevue continues to sit below the 85-point threshold; /about and /projects dipped modestly but remain above it — all three sub-85 pages are persistent and warrant action on LCP/TBT.

About page with dark header, 'About Me' hero, animated code-block panel showing the developer object, stat counters (12+, 16+, 2, 7), an Engineering Culture section with particle animation, and a full-width contact form at the footer, all rendering cleanly on desktop and mobile.

Projects index with a teal 'Fuel the projects' CTA banner, three featured Latest Builds (Token Field, Noise Translator, Tail Risk Lab) with waveform/bar-chart visuals, and a 3-column all-projects grid (7 cards including ToS Watchdog) followed by a contact form, all rendering correctly on desktop and mobile.

Clinical Note Structurer project page with a green 'Evals: 10/10 passing' badge, two-column visit-note / structured-result demo panel, synthetic-sample buttons, an amber disclaimer banner, and expandable JSON / architecture accordion sections, all clean on desktop and mobile.

Screenshot → PrimeVue project page with a green 'Evals: 5/5 passing' badge, a dashed drag-and-drop upload zone, three sample screenshot thumbnails (Login form, Analytics dashboard, Pricing page) stacking cleanly on mobile, and a scaffold-output placeholder below, rendering correctly on desktop and mobile.
